grid.note: the ticket fixes the interval [0.2, 0.9] and 18 points; at a 0.05 step that interval holds 15 points, so the step is flattened to 0.0412 rather than moving either endpoint

protocol.positive: an answerable golden item: it should be answered
protocol.negative: a near-miss golden item: it should be abstained on
protocol.decision: answer iff transform(top_score) >= t, matching generate.py, which abstains when score < threshold
protocol.working_point_rule: maximise F1 of the answer class subject to over_abstain_rate_on_answerable <= 0.05; if infeasible at every t, choose the smallest over-abstain rate and break ties on F1; ties always go to the largest t
protocol.dedupe: one row per golden item_id per mode; when a mode has several runs the newest supersedes the older
protocol.score: top score = max over retrieved[] score, the quantity generate.abstain_score_threshold is compared against

grid_support.note: those t points sit past the highest score any run in this mode produced, so their raw thresholds are extrapolations of the fitted normal rather than reachable numbers; they stay in the curve for completeness and are never candidates for the working point, which must be a threshold the system can actually cross

hybrid.scale: RRF fused sum, ~1/(rrf_k + rank); with rrf_k=60 and k=10 the observed range is about [0.015, 0.035], so no threshold in [0.2, 0.9] is reachable raw
hybrid.justification: Applied the pre-registered rule: among the 18 grid points, the largest F1 whose over-abstention on answerable items stays inside the 0.05 budget is F1=0.7143 at t=0.4059, which is the raw score 0.030432 for this mode. There it answers 10/10 answerable items (over-abstain 0.0000, recall 1.0000) and answers 8/10 near-misses (under-abstain 0.8000), so precision is 0.5556. t is on the normalized scale (zscore-normal-cdf): the RRF sum is an unbounded-ish reciprocal-rank artifact with no absolute meaning; its z-score against the run's own distribution is the only comparable quantity, and the inverse maps every t back to a raw sum. The grid spans t=0.2000..0.9000 on a nominal 0.05 step flattened to 18 points over [0.2, 0.9]. Only 0.030432 may be written into `generate.abstain_score_threshold` for the hybrid mode; the normalized t transfers nowhere else, and this raw number transfers to no other mode either. The curve rests on 10 answerable and 10 near-miss items from golden v0, so every rate moves in steps of 1/10 and the working point is a v0 estimate until golden v1 is labelled.

rerank.scale: cross-encoder score in [0, 1], clustered high: answerable items in the runs on disk score 0.77-1.00 while near-misses reach 0.97

The grid spans t=0.2000..0.9000 on a nominal 0.05 step flattened to 18 points over [0.2, 0.9]. Only 0.75925 may be written into `generate.abstain_score_threshold` for the rerank mode; the normalized t transfers nowhere else, and this raw number transfers to no other mode either.
